games.summary: The most lopsided matchup of the round. Wheelo rates Melbourne 29.9pts above Richmond on underlying quality, and RIC's structural scoring collapse (16.6% I50 efficiency, scoring 8 goals per game average) leaves them with no realistic path to winning. Gawn (SC 134.2) has zero viable ruck opposition with both Nankervis and Ryan unavailable. Melbourne won at MCG by 20 and 43 in the last two R7 fixtures at this venue. The line has moved 3pts further toward Melbourne post-teams, confirming market consensus. RIC's worsening trajectory (loss margins escalating 42, 56, 75) with no bounce-back adjustment applicable under Rule 23 makes this as close to a certainty as AFL gets.
